name: Scene Templates Collection
description: Ready-to-use scene templates for robot visualization

studio.name: Product Photography Studio
studio.description: Clean studio environment for professional robot renders
studio.prompt:
Set up a professional product photography studio:

1. Environment:
   - Delete all default objects
   - Create seamless backdrop (cyclorama):
     - Large curved plane from floor to wall
     - Smooth transition, no hard edge
     - White or light gray color RGB(0.9, 0.9, 0.92)

2. Ground:
   - Reflective floor option:
     - Glossy material, roughness 0.1
     - Subtle reflection of robot
   - Or matte option:
     - Roughness 0.8 for soft shadows

3. Lighting Setup:
   Key Light:
   - Area light, size 2m x 2m
   - Position: (3, -2, 4)
   - Power: 1500W
   - Soft shadows

   Fill Light:
   - Area light, size 3m x 3m
   - Position: (-3, -1, 3)
   - Power: 600W
   - Very soft

   Rim/Back Light:
   - Area light, size 1m x 2m
   - Position: (0, 4, 3)
   - Power: 800W
   - Creates edge definition

   Top Light (optional):
   - Softbox above robot
   - For even fill

4. Camera:
   - Position: (1.5, -1.5, 0.8)
   - Focal length: 85mm
   - F-stop: 4.0 for slight DOF
   - Focus on robot center

5. Render Settings:
   - Cycles engine
   - Samples: 256
   - Denoising enabled
   - Resolution: 2048x2048 (square)
   - Transparent background option

6. Color Management:
   - View: Filmic
   - Look: Medium Contrast
   - Exposure: 0

warehouse.name: Industrial Warehouse
warehouse.description: Warehouse environment with shelving and industrial lighting
warehouse.prompt:
Create an industrial warehouse environment:

1. Structure:
   - Large open space: 20m x 30m x 8m
   - Concrete floor with texture
   - Metal support columns every 5m
   - Visible ceiling structure (beams/trusses)

2. Floor:
   - Concrete material with:
     - Base color: RGB(0.4, 0.4, 0.42)
     - Roughness: 0.7
     - Normal map for texture
   - Painted lane markings:
     - Yellow safety lines
     - Blue pedestrian paths
     - White zone boundaries
   - Subtle oil stains and wear

3. Shelving/Racking:
   - Industrial pallet racking:
     - Orange/blue steel frames
     - 3 levels high (each 2m)
     - Spaced 3m apart
   - Pallets on shelves:
     - Wooden pallets 1.2m x 1m
     - Cardboard boxes stacked
     - Wrapped packages

4. Lighting:
   - High bay LED lights:
     - 6500K color temperature
     - Pendant style fixtures
     - Array across ceiling
   - Natural light from:
     - Skylights (translucent panels)
     - Loading dock doors (partially open)

5. Props:
   - Forklift in background
   - Pallet jack nearby
   - Safety signs and posters
   - Fire extinguisher on column
   - First aid station
   - Clock on wall

6. Atmosphere:
   - Slight dust in air (volume scatter)
   - Light beams from skylights

7. Camera positions:
   - Wide shot showing context
   - Robot-eye-level action shot
   - Overhead path planning view

outdoor_urban.name: Urban Outdoor Environment
outdoor_urban.description: City sidewalk/street scene for delivery robots
outdoor_urban.prompt:
Create an urban outdoor environment:

1. Ground Surface:
   - Concrete sidewalk:
     - Expansion joints every 1.5m
     - Slight color variation per slab
     - Weathered texture
   - Asphalt road section:
     - Darker material
     - Road markings
     - Manhole cover

2. Environment Lighting:
   - Use HDRI sky:
     - Search Poly Haven: 'urban_street' or 'city'
     - Or create procedural sky
   - Sun position:
     - Golden hour angle (15-20° above horizon)
     - Creates long shadows
   - Ambient: from sky HDRI

3. Urban Props:
   Street Furniture:
   - Street lamp post
   - Bench (wooden slats, metal frame)
   - Trash bin (city style)
   - Bike rack
   - Planter box with small tree

   Infrastructure:
   - Curb edge
   - Storm drain
   - Parking meter
   - Traffic sign

   Background:
   - Building facades (simple)
   - Parked cars (low detail)
   - Pedestrian silhouettes

4. Details:
   - Fallen leaves
   - Gum spots on sidewalk
   - Cracks and repairs
   - Puddles (optional)

5. Atmosphere:
   - Slight haze for depth
   - Warm golden tones

6. Camera:
   - Street level perspective
   - Wide establishing shot
   - Dynamic action angle

laboratory.name: Robotics Research Lab
laboratory.prompt:
Create a robotics research laboratory:

1. Room Structure:
   - Size: 8m x 6m x 3m
   - White walls with minimal texture
   - Anti-static tile flooring:
     - Gray tiles 0.6m x 0.6m
     - Subtle grid pattern

2. Lighting:
   - Fluorescent panels:
     - 2x4 recessed fixtures
     - 6500K daylight color
     - Even, shadow-free illumination
   - Task lighting:
     - Desk lamps at workstations
     - Adjustable arms

3. Lab Equipment:
   Workstations:
   - Lab bench with:
     - Computer monitors (2-3)
     - Keyboard and mouse
     - Oscilloscope
     - Multimeter
     - Soldering station

   Testing Area:
   - Motion capture volume markers
   - Calibration pattern on wall
   - Robot testing platform
   - Safety barriers

   Storage:
   - Tool wall/pegboard
   - Parts bins
   - Component drawers

4. Props:
   - Whiteboard with diagrams
   - 3D printer in corner
   - Spare robot parts on shelf
   - Safety goggles hanging
   - Lab coats on hooks
   - Coffee mug on desk

5. Technical Details:
   - Cable management trays
   - Network switches
   - Power strips
   - Grounding straps

6. Camera:
   - Documentary style
   - Clean technical views
   - Detail shots possible

abstract_tech.name: Abstract Technology Showcase
abstract_tech.description: Stylized environment for dramatic hero shots
abstract_tech.prompt:
Create an abstract technology showcase:

1. Environment:
   - Dark void background:
     - Near black: RGB(0.02, 0.02, 0.03)
     - Slight blue or purple tint
   - No visible horizon
   - Infinite feel

2. Ground Surface:
   - Reflective dark plane:
     - Color: RGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.08)
     - High gloss (roughness 0.05)
     - Perfect mirror reflection
   - Or grid pattern:
     - Glowing lines
     - Tech aesthetic
     - Emission material for lines

3. Lighting:
   - Dramatic rim lighting:
     - Cyan accent: RGB(0, 0.8, 1.0)
     - Position behind robot
     - Creates edge glow
   - Magenta counter:
     - RGB(1.0, 0, 0.6)
     - Opposite side
     - Subtle fill
   - Minimal key light:
     - Just enough to see details
     - Preserves drama

4. Effects:
   - Volumetric fog:
     - Very subtle density
     - Light beams visible
   - Bloom/glare:
     - On bright elements
     - Compositor effect
   - Particle systems:
     - Floating dust motes
     - Data visualization dots

5. Abstract Elements:
   - Floating geometric shapes:
     - Hexagons (Solana reference)
     - Wire frame objects
     - Holographic appearance
   - Tech UI projections:
     - Floating text/data
     - Emission planes
   - Solana logo elements:
     - Gradient glows
     - Animated potential

6. Camera:
   - Low angle hero shot
   - Shallow depth of field
   - Orbital motion path

7. Render Settings:
   - High samples (512+)
   - Denoising essential
   - Bloom in compositor
   - High contrast grade
